verdict.rationale: Cline ships an official CLI, installed via `npm install -g cline`, that supports interactive terminal chat and headless runs. Documented examples include `cline --auto-approve true "run tests and fix failures"` and piping `git diff | cline`, and it can run fully locally with Ollama or LM Studio models. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the CLI specifically; the community comments address Cline in the editor, not the terminal CLI.
